items.exampleEn: The base of the lamp is heavy.
This farm produces milk and cheese.
items.exampleZh: 這座農場生產牛奶和起司。

items.exampleEn: Can you check these figures for me?
items.exampleZh: 你可以幫我檢查一下這些數字嗎？

items.exampleEn: Our plane landed in Tokyo at ten.
items.exampleZh: 我們的飛機十點在東京降落。

items.exampleEn: I didn't realize it was so late.
items.exampleZh: 我沒發覺已經這麼晚了。

items.exampleEn: Many young people come to the city to seek work.
items.exampleZh: 很多年輕人到城市來找工作。

items.exampleEn: The blue line on the map represents the river.
items.exampleZh: 地圖上的藍線代表河流。

items.sentenceEn: I didn't realize you were here.

items.audioEn: The plane will land at eight, so I'll be home by ten.
items.audioZh: 飛機八點降落，所以我十點前會到家。

items.sentenceEn: He hit his head on the door.
This area produces very good tea.
items.sentenceZh: 這個地區出產很好的茶。

items.stemEn: Our plane will ____ in Taipei in one hour.
items.stemZh: 我們的飛機一小時後會在台北降落。

items.stemEn: Each color on this map ____ a different country.
items.stemZh: 這張地圖上的每一種顏色代表不同的國家。

items.passageEn: My uncle has a small factory that produces chairs. Last year, he looked at the sales figures and realized that his chairs were too expensive. So he decided to seek new ideas. He designed a simple chair with a strong wooden base. It became his most popular chair. "For me, this chair represents a new start," he says.
items.passageZh: 我叔叔有一間生產椅子的小工廠。去年他看了銷售數字，發覺他的椅子太貴了。於是他決定尋找新點子。他設計了一張有堅固木頭底座的簡單椅子，結果成了他最受歡迎的椅子。他說：「對我來說，這張椅子代表一個新的開始。」

questions.questionZh: 叔叔看了銷售數字後發覺什麼？
叔叔設計的新椅子有什麼特點？
options: 很大，還有很軟的布料椅墊
可以摺起來，放進小車子裡
簡單，有堅固的木頭底座

items.promptZh: 我到家才發覺手機忘在辦公室了。
referenceEn: When I got home, I realized I left my phone at the office.
I realized I had left my phone in the office when I got home.
rubricZh: realize 後面可接子句（例如 realized I left…、realized that…）
過去的事用過去式（例如 realized、left；寫 had left 也正確）
「到家」可寫例如 got home、arrived home

items.instructionZh: 用 produce 造一個句子，說說某個地方或工廠生產什麼。
referenceEn: Taiwan produces a lot of fruit.
rubricZh: produce 後面接產品（例如 produces shoes）
主詞是第三人稱單數時動詞要加 s（例如 produces）
